plugins.name: acl-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse Bash gate enforcing a project ACL. Vendored from clarity-auto-care.

plugins.name: comment-guard-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse file-tool gate: caps Python function and class docstrings (and own-line comment blocks) at 3 lines.

plugins.name: no-shirk-hook
plugins.description: Stop hook that blocks the agent from ending a turn with an ask-instead-of-do question.

plugins.name: fs-acl-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse file-tool gate: a path-based ACL for Write/Edit/Read (the file-tool sibling of acl-hook).

plugins.name: branch-guard-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse file-tool gate: denies file edits (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) while a protected branch (main/master) is checked out.

plugins.name: delegation-hook
plugins.description: PreToolUse delegation gate: subagents run in the background so the session is never frozen waiting for one, and each gets a 30 tool-call / 7-minute budget before its tools are cut off.

plugins.name: review-panel
plugins.description: A panel of eight read-only reviewer subagents, dispatched by a PreToolUse hook over every commit of 64+ changed lines.

plugins.name: deep-investigation
plugins.description: Skill + three subagents that answer a why-question by enumerating every hypothesis first, then falsifying branches until one mechanism accounts for the whole effect.

plugins.name: usable-ui
plugins.description: Skill deciding UI wording, control, placement and states, plus five read-only UI reviewers, supplied by a PreToolUse hook while UI is written and once it is committed.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Skill and script that put a question to Gemini through Vertex AI — a model that has not read this session — and bring the answer back as an argument to check, not an authority to follow.

plugins.name: pr-flow
plugins.description: Skill that writes PR descriptions a reviewer can act on, a CI script whose one backgroundable call carries a branch from a CI verdict through the merge to the deploy that ships it — GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build — while printing only the failing log, a PreToolUse hook that denies that wait in the foreground so it never freezes the session, plus a PostToolUse hook that says what the branch still owes — a push, a PR, a refreshed body, a green CI, a live change — right after each commit and push.

plugins.name: agent-knowledge
plugins.description: Keeps the knowledge an agent loads lean and current, starting with CLAUDE.md. A PostToolUse gate holds every CLAUDE.md to one skeleton: an auto-stamped `Updated:` date, mandatory Business decisions and Technical decisions sections, a 200-line limit, no dead paths, no decisions duplicated from a parent file. Ships the skill that writes to that skeleton and an audit CLI.
